Task Guide: Task: Simulate the diffusion of a 2D Lennard-Jones (LJ) fluid and compute the diffusion coefficient via the mean-squared displacement (MSD) method. The simulation should use Lennard-Jones units and define a 40x40 simulation box in two dimensions with a number density of 0.6. The atoms should be initialized on a square lattice and interact via a Lennard-Jones potential with parameters epsilon = 1.0, sigma = 1.0, and a cutoff radius of 2.5. Use timestep of 0.005 lj units. First, equilibrate the system using an NVE ensemble with a Langevin thermostat at a temperature of 1.0 for 5000 steps. After equilibration, remove the thermostat and reset the timestep. Then, run a 100,000-step NVE simulation and compute the mean-squared displacement (MSD) and the instantaneous slope-derived diffusion coefficient over time during the run. As the final output, return the final diffusion constant in reduced Lennard-Jones (LJ) units. Make sure all the associated files for this task (input files, log files, any other files) are in the /results/md_tutorials/13_July_2025/react/gpt_4o/brief/task_6/task_6_trial_2 directory. You can use the available I/O tools (e.g., write_file) make new files .etc. Whatever potentials you need to run the simulation, you can find them at /potentials/. A type of potential can be accessed by /potentials/TYPE where TYPE can be [EAM, TERSOFF, REAXFF] which further contains the exact potential files. Note that in case of reaxff potentials, pair style 'reax/c' has been renamed to 'reaxff' and always use NULL for the control file (cfile), for example, this syntax is correct : pair_style reaxff NULL. If the task is to give the final output as a scalar, only return the numerical value, without any units.

# LAMMPS input script for 2D Lennard-Jones fluid diffusion

units lj
dimension 2
boundary p p p
atom_style atomic

# Create a 40x40 simulation box with number density 0.6
lattice sq2 0.6
region box block 0 40 0 40 -0.5 0.5
create_box 1 box
create_atoms 1 box

# Define LJ potential
pair_style lj/cut 2.5
pair_coeff 1 1 1.0 1.0 2.5

# Set up neighbor list
neighbor 0.3 bin
neigh_modify every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Set initial velocities
velocity all create 1.0 12345

# Equilibration with Langevin thermostat
fix 1 all nve
fix 2 all langevin 1.0 1.0 0.1 12345
thermo 100
run 5000

# Remove thermostat and reset timestep
unfix 2
timestep 0.005

# Run production simulation
variable msd equal msd(all)
fix 3 all ave/time 100 1 100 v_msd file msd.txt
run 100000

# Output final diffusion coefficient
variable diff equal v_msd/(4*step*dt)
print "Final diffusion coefficient: ${diff}"
"}
